map.📚 深度解析：隧道掘进速度估算: 📚 Deep Dive: Tunnel Advance Rate Estimate
map.单循环进尺：循环进尺=炮孔深度×炮孔利用率 η（一般 0.85~0.95，由岩性: Advance per cycle: cycle advance = blast-hole depth × utilization η (generally 0.85–0.95, determined by rock type and drilling accuracy). Greater hole depth can increase advance, but η usually falls accordingly.
map.循环时间与循环数：单循环时间=钻孔+爆破+通风+出渣+支护各工序耗时之和；时间允: Cycle time and cycle count: cycle time is the sum of drilling, blasting, ventilation, mucking and support. Time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ cycle time); actual cycles = min(planned cycles, time-allowed cycles), so both planning and time constrain the result.
map.进尺与工期：日进尺=单循环进尺×实际循环数，月进尺=日进尺×30；工具另按 10: Advance and schedule: daily advance = advance per cycle × actual cycles, monthly advance = daily advance × 30. The tool also estimates schedule months for a 1,000 m single-heading drive as 1,000 ÷ daily advance ÷ 30, to compare the marginal benefit of different operation combinations (e.g., adding a drilling jumbo to shorten drilling time, or optimizing mucking to shorten the cycle).
map.算例：孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9 的全断面法日进尺: Example: daily advance for a full-face method with 3 m hole depth and 0.9 utilization
map.Input: 孔深 3 m、利用率 0.9、钻孔 3 h、爆破 1 h、通风 0: Input: hole depth 3 m, utilization 0.9, drilling 3 h, blasting 1 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 3 h, support 2 h, planned cycles 3/day. Advance per cycle = 3 × 0.9 = 2.70 m; cycle time = 3 + 1 + 0.5 + 3 + 2 = 9.50 h; time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ 9.5) = 2/day; actual cycles = min(3, 2) = 2/day (limited by time, not plan); daily advance = 2.70 × 2 = 5.40 m; monthly advance (full load) = 162 m; 1,000 m schedule ≈ 6.2 months. Comparison: hole depth 4 m and drilling 4 h (others unchanged) → advance 3.60 m, cycle 10.50 h, 2 cycles/day, daily advance 7.20 m, monthly 216 m, schedule 4.6 months; a short-advance fast-cycle option (hole depth 2 m, η=0.85, drilling 2 h, blasting 0.5 h, ventilation 0.5 h, mucking 2 h, support 1.5 h, planned 4 cycles/day) → advance 1.70 m, cycle 6.50 h, floor(24 ÷ 6.5) = 3 cycles/day, daily advance 5.10 m, monthly 153 m, schedule 6.5 months.
map.为什么实际循环数常常小于我填写的计划循环数？: Why is the actual cycle count often lower than my planned count?
map.因为工具取 min(计划循环数, floor(24÷单循环时间))。当五个工序耗: Because the tool takes min(planned cycles, floor(24 ÷ cycle time)). When the five operations add up to a long cycle, the planned count simply cannot fit into a day; the bottleneck is cycle time, not planning. To speed up, optimize the longest operation: if drilling dominates, add a drilling jumbo or multi-boom drill and use deeper-hole blasting; if mucking dominates, increase haulage capacity and shorten the haul; if support is slow, separate temporary shotcrete support from later permanent support.
map.炮孔利用率 η 一般取多少，加大孔深一定会更快吗？: What value should blast-hole utilization η take, and does a deeper hole always mean faster advance?
map.η 通常在 0.85~0.95：完整硬岩、钻孔精度高时取 0.90~0.95，破: η is usually 0.85–0.95: 0.90–0.95 for intact hard rock with accurate drilling, around 0.85 or lower for fractured zones and soft rock. A deeper hole raises advance per cycle, but deep-hole drilling takes longer, confinement is stronger, η often drops, and the longer cycle reduces daily cycles, so there is an optimal hole depth. Compare several 2–4 m depth and operation combinations with this tool and choose the one with the highest daily advance.

Advance per cycle = 3 × 0.9 = 2.70 m; cycle time = 3 + 1 + 0.5 + 3 + 2 = 9.50 h; time-allowed cycles = floor(24 ÷ 9.5) = 2/day; actual cycles = min(3, 2) = 2/day (limited by time, not plan); daily advance = 2.70 × 2 = 5.40 m; monthly advance (full load) = 162 m; 1,000 m schedule ≈ 6.2 months.
